changes: Blueprints: place a structure as ghost blocks from the Structures page; anyone in the world can build it
Hold Place while aiming into a blueprint to fill its ghost cells with the right blocks, one at a time
Ghost blocks you don't have show red, and a small panel lists each block you have and need
Builders, villagers without swords, come and build blueprints near you
Four simple test blueprints: a hut, a wall, a well and a watchtower
